head_coach.name: Julen Lopetegui
head_coach.play_style_summary: Possession-based tactical play emphasizing structured defensive organization, control through a technically proficient midfield, patient build-up, and rapid counter-attacking transitions utilizing fast wingers in wide areas.

key_players.name: Akram Afif
key_players.performance_stats: In 11 qualification matches, he created 69 goalscoring chances, provided 11 assists, and averaged an 80% passing accuracy.

key_players.name: Almoez Ali
key_players.performance_stats: Finished as the top goalscorer in the Asian qualifiers with 12 goals in 14 matches, boasting a high shot conversion rate as the team's primary striker.

key_players.name: Homam Al-Amin
key_players.performance_stats: Contributed 4 assists across 17 qualification matches, creating 14 key chances with a strong 61% duel success rate on the left flank.
